defects.evidence: A deliberately broken WorkStore wrapper deduplicated duplicate ids in getMany(). The pre-fix shared runConformance suite accepted all 18 scenarios because it never asserted batch slot cardinality or the duplicate third slot.

Review 5149212380 identified non-binding due-limit evidence, unchecked scoped assurance anchors, an unverified lifecycle mutation-spec substitution, unbounded deferred/process waits, and other harness paths that could hang or misstate the verdict.

requiredFix: Shared conformance must reject duplicate-slot collapse; proof/refinement controls must bind the intended limit/specification/section and terminate boundedly on regressions.
